scope: Seven fixed-loadout Space Marines profiles transcribed into the current-reference profile source. official_updates.title: Warhammer 40,000 – Balance Update: Emboldened Astartes
official_updates.cross_checked: GW states most Tacticus and Terminator profiles gain +1 Toughness; Gravis profiles are excluded; boltguns and chainswords generally gain +1 Strength, and some gain +1 AP.
official_updates.limit: The article is a change summary and does not reproduce each Codex datasheet, fixed loadout or ability text. Exact current Codex/app applicability remains unverified.

profiles.source_delta: T5 and current weapon profiles replace the starter-pack T4 / S4 rifle values. Current sheet also offers Focused Fire bolt rifle mode; this fixed roster uses Saturation only.
T5 and S5 chainsword replace the starter-pack T4 / S4 profile. Current ability is Targeted Intercession.

Current-reference profile replaces the historical Roboute Guilliman characteristics, loadout and prices. The Emperor's Sword CLEAVE 2 effect is implemented in the attack planner; this is not official Codex locator certification.

runtime_migration.fixed_marine_profiles: Loaded by scripts/edition_11/current_reference_marine_profiles.gd in the experimental fixed-profile materializer. Its identifier and data digest are included in the match content hash.
runtime_migration.known_issue: The separate mixed-core training mode and Necron profiles still use the historical pack. Optional wargear and non-default profile variants are not part of the seven-profile source snapshot. Guilliman has a transcribed profile but no selection path: admitting him to the legacy mixed-core builder would use a stale 355-point discovery value, while checked-roster validation intentionally excludes him pending source reconciliation.
runtime_migration.next_step: Reconcile exact official Codex/app effects and applicable updates per fixed datasheet, then add profiles through a current-reference roster path with the captured current prices. Keep checked_roster capability blocked until that reconciliation and complete required effects are done.
runtime_migration.support_claim: No profile in this snapshot is certified as a current complete Codex datasheet or full legal army entry.
